title: Project view
responsibility: Render `/`: the project's current stage derived from stage definitions and recorded attestations, navigation across all nine stages with each one's gate state, artifact counts, and lint findings. Report only counts it actually rendered.
notes: ⚠️ PLANNED, NOT BUILT (2026-08-27). `implementedBy` is absent, and its absence is the only signal in this artifact that says so — the same convention CMP-0011 established, and the same hazard QST-0015 named: creating these records takes the orphan count to zero while nothing exists. 'Every requirement traces to a component' becomes true; 'the shell works' does not. ⚠️ DERIVED, NEVER STORED (#16). Stage position is computed from definitions plus attestations on every read; there is no status field to go stale. ⚠️ THE TRUTHFUL-COUNT RULE IS THIS COMPONENT'S SHARPEST CONSTRAINT and it comes from a measured defect: AST-0035 found the skeleton reporting 178 artifacts while rendering 177, because a malformed file vanished and the total did not move. A count is a claim, and a claim about content that was not rendered is false. No partial-failure exception. ⚠️ OUTSIDE ITS BOUNDARY: it surfaces lint findings, it does not re-judge them (#47). ⚠️ HALF BUILT 2026-08-28 BY TSK-0007: the derived current stage and all nine stages with their gate state. ACC-0013 passes, measured in production. ⚠️ ACC-0014, ACC-0015 AND ACC-0035 REMAIN `not-evaluated`. Counts, the lint surface and located parse failures are TSK-0016's, and URL-recoverable selection is TSK-0010's. The split was made because this half fails VISIBLY — a wrong stage is obvious — while the counting half fails silently, and they deserve separate review. ⚠️ THE READ LIVES IN `<StagesPanel />`, RENDERED LITERALLY INSIDE A `<Suspense>` AT THE PAGE'S OWN CALL SITE, and that form is now enforced rather than conventional: renaming it or handing it to a wrapper is refused as unsupported indirection, and removing the boundary is refused as a missing one. Both were falsified against this very file.
